answer: Re-attestations are stored in plume and river lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 16 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the wharf graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1299 impostors cost 430 times the honest price and take 30 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
